newsitems.contents: [h1]PATCH NOTES #6[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Stability & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some game modes could have more players than authorized after host migration, [b]especially visible in 2v2 Wingman.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved match reliability around host migration player limits.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several weapon-state issues related to ammo visibility, reloads, swaps, and dropped weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Film Grain setting not being applied properly.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Progression & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the [b]Reissad Points cap to 50,000[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added UI indications when players reach the maximum Reissad Points cap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player count refresh inconsistencies in the server browser UI.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Anti-AFK[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved AFK kick notification reliability.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Weapons, Animations & Equipment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bolt-action weapons sometimes stopping their reload due to running out of ammo in the pool.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bolt-action weapons with a full magazine blocking other actions after reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved bullet visibility logic so ammunition displays more consistently during mag checks, reloads, firing, and similar weapon states.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some weapon animations continuing after swapping or dropping a weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped weapon animation audio when swapping or dropping weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Glock hammer animation issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Glock inspect animations to remove elbow issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Deagle Ifriee bundle issue.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tablet & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the default tablet screen material behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Party system & general update[/b][/p][p]Short one this week. The party system isn't ready yet, but it's going well. The team made good progress, what we're building is getting solid on our end, and our internal tests look better than last week. We just need more time on it.[/p][p]That's also why today's patch is likely the last v0.8 patch for a now. If something urgent comes up that we can fix quickly, we'll still push it, but otherwise we're now fully focused on the party system, the anti-cheat and other stuff that we gonna reveal later. So expect updates from us less often for a bit. The next one shouldn't be a patch but a minor/intermediate update, and we'll give you more visibility on what's in it as soon as we can.[/p][p]The plan on the party system hasn't changed: get a first version we're happy with internally, then put it on an experimental branch so you can stress test it and tell us what breaks.[/p][p]We're also finishing to post mortem with the team on this past year. It's been a rollercoaster, and the results of this last update went well beyond what we expected, so we're pretty happy with where we landed, even if there is still stuff to handle. We're going through all the feedback you've left us, here and everywhere else, to work out the best plan for what comes next and share it with you.[/p][p]Thanks for your patience.[/p]

newsitems.title: Bodycam PATCH NOTES · V0.8 #3
newsitems.author: ReissadStudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]PATCH NOTES #3[/h1][p][b]
[/b]Hi everyone,[/p][p align="start"]Earlier today, we identified a way for a session host to remote crash other players’ games by spawning hundreds of entities. We have banned the players identified as abusing it and released a patch addressing the issue in this latest update.[/p][p align="start"][b]
Why didn’t we communicate immediately?[/b][/p][p align="start"]
We wanted to establish the facts before making a public statement. We contacted the players involved, investigated the reports, and reviewed our network code to understand how the exploit was being used. This took the entire day, and during that time, we could not confidently confirm or dismiss the claims circulating online.[/p][p align="start"]So far, the only confirmed use we have identified [b]is a host causing other players’ games to crash within their session.[/b] After contacting players and investigating the reports, [b]we have found no evidence that this exploit has been used for any other purpose or to access players’ personal data.[/b][/p][p align="start"]
We needed time to investigate. However, [b]we should have let you know that we were investigating, even before we had all the answers.[/b] We apologize for leaving you without clear updates during that time.[/p][p align="start"]BODYCAM has performed incredibly well, [b]far beyond our expectations[/b], and we are grateful for the support from our community. Unfortunately, increased visibility can also attract people with bad intentions, whether through attempts to disrupt the game or spread misinformation to encourage review bombing.[/p][p align="start"]
We believe some individuals may be deliberately flooding our social channels with unverified claims to create fear and damage the studio’s reputation following this success. We remain focused on establishing the facts and taking players’ concerns seriously.[/p][p align="start"][b]
Progression and economy[/b][/p][p align="start"]One of your biggest complaints has been the economy: weapon attachments cost too much, and earning currency takes too long.[/p][p align="start"]Even before today’s incident, we had seen players turning to currency farming and exploits to progress at a reasonable pace. [b]We addressed that problem in the wrong way. We focused on the symptoms without doing enough to fix the underlying issue: progression felt too slow.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Today’s patch makes the following changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Restored currency earnings in private lobbies[/b], allowing players to progress while playing with friends or bots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Set private lobby earnings to 50% of the standard rate.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced weapon attachment prices by 25–30%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed an exploit in Versus that allowed excessive currency gains.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]BODYCAM is first and foremost a multiplayer PvP game, and we want public matches to remain the main path for progression.[/p][p align="start"]At the same time, players who prefer private sessions should still be able to earn currency and unlock equipment. Restoring private lobby rewards at 50% of the standard rate is our way of supporting those players while keeping public matches active.[/p][p align="start"]If too many players use private lobbies to farm currency faster than they could in public matches, fewer players are available for public matchmaking, making it harder to fill lobbies and keep matches flowing smoothly.[/p][p align="start"]These changes are a step toward making progression more rewarding and reducing the grind. We will continue monitoring your feedback and adjusting the economy.[/p][p align="start"]That said, we'll try to communicate better in the future, even when we don't have all the info. I just want to say congratulations to all the devs who, despite all the hate from the review bombing we received in the last 24 hours, managed to find solutions.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your support and for being direct with us about what needs to improve. Please check information before sharing it, follow our official updates, and report suspicious activity directly to our team.  

[b]Thanks ![/b][/p]

newsitems.title: Bodycam PATCH NOTES · V0.8 #2
newsitems.author: ReissadStudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]PATCH NOTES #2[/h1][p][b]
Progression & Rewards[/b]
• Increased Reissad Points gain multipliers across game modes:
　• Gun Game: +25%
　• Team Deathmatch: +50%
　• Deathmatch: +50%
　• Hardpoint: +75%
　• Wingman: +100%
　• Versus: +100%

[b]Loadout & Customization[/b]
• Updated the Glock Ifriee and Harvos presentation.
• Updated the default reticle setup.
• Fixed several broken or incorrect weapon, attachment, and equipment meshes, including issues affecting the Glock, AKS-74U, MP5, RaiderX, SVD, weapon lights, magazines, and Sentinel parts.

[b]Audio[/b]
• Moved Hardpoint capture audio cues back to the [b]UI[/b] audio slider in the options.
• Boosted Hardpoint win, loss, and contest audio feedback.
• Slightly adjusted the pitch of Hardpoint loss and contest feedback.

[b]Maps[/b]
• Fixed several Lobby visual issues.
• Replaced deprecated glass materials in the Lobby.
• Fixed awkward reflections on reinforced glass.
• Adjusted local Lobby lighting.
• Fixed and improved several decal and material issues.

[b]Stability & Fixes[/b]
• Fixed a crash that could occur during online initialization.
• Fixed several static mesh issues that could cause broken visuals on weapons, attachments, equipment, or environment props.



[b]Keep in mind that these are just quick fixes we were able to push out today. Other people on the team are working on broader fixes for issues that take longer to resolve, such as the party system, matchmaking, anti-cheat, and others. The point of these patch notes is simply for the live ops team to address the issues that can be resolved in a single day.

Thanks ![/b][/p]

[h2]Patch Notes · V0.8 #1[/h2][previewyoutube="AQ3DPo2fvSc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h2]Settings & Controls[/h2][list][*][p]Added an individual player mute button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a DLSS Multi Frame Generation setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Film Grain setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to clear keybinds.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved key conflict handling.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrectly detected keybind conflicts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect description when rebinding keys.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tablet inputs being consumed by gameplay controls.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Match Flow & Game Modes[/h2][list][*][p]Increased score limits:[/p][list][*][p]Team Deathmatch: 50 → 75 kills.[/p][/*][*][p]Deathmatch: 30 → 40 kills.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reorganized the map list, with [b]Trenches[/b] now appearing first.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Gun Game that caused too many pistols to appear in the weapon pool.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a client-side Wingman defuse issue that could cause a softlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bolt-action weapons could stop reloading correctly after several full reloads.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a disruptive camera-correction animation that could heavily obstruct the view while the bodycam was readjusting.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Loadout, Audio & Maps[/h2][list][*][p]Improved scope capture performance, optimization, and visual stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Lumen scalability behavior in scope views.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved drone audio.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing music to the Lobby jukebox.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed excessive reflective artifacts on reinforced glass in the Lobby.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Stability & Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Added a clear error message when the game cannot log in through Steam. Previously, this could result in a black screen with no explanation.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]A Note on the Most Asked Questions
 [/h2][h3]Zombie Mode[/h3][p]Zombie Mode has been temporarily disabled.[/p][p]While reworking the rest of the game, a few regressions affected the mode, and we also felt it had become too stagnant. Rather than leave it in that state, we have decided to bring it back stronger for a future event, with Halloween coming up very soon.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Playing With Friends[/h3][p]We know that playing easily with friends is currently one of the main areas that needs improvement.[/p][p]A completely new Party System is already in development. It will allow you to:[/p][list][*][p]Invite friends to your group.[/p][/*][*][p]Queue for matchmaking together across all game modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Join ongoing matches directly from the Server Browser.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In the meantime, you can still play with friends by inviting them to your lobby and creating a custom match.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Progression & Economy[/h3][p]Many of you have shared feedback about weapon and attachment prices. The message is clear: progression is currently too slow.[/p][p]We are monitoring the economy closely and will make adjustments very soon, including rebalancing certain prices and improving the overall progression experience.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]What's Next[/h3][p]Several other important improvements are already a top priority and will be addressed soon. This includes new systems to address disruptive behavior in matches, such as AFK players and team killing, as well as the ability to switch teams.[/p][p]And of course, one of the community’s most requested topics: [b]Anti-Cheat.[/b] Its integration is already well underway. We chose not to rush it into this update so it can launch under the best possible conditions.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Thank you for your feedback and support.[/i][/p][p][b]The Bodycam Team[/b][/p]

newsitems.author: ReissadStudio

[h2]A Message from Luca, Léo & the Reissad Team[/h2][p]First of all, thank you.[/p][p]This update is very important to us. [b]It marks the transition from a game we developed as two brothers in our bedroom, driven purely by passion and built through years of late nights, into something much bigger.[/b][/p][p]When Bodycam launched in Early Access in 2024, you trusted us. [b]You played the game, loved it, and asked us to take it to the next level[/b]. Our dream was always to build a [b]real game studio around that ambition, and over the past year, that is exactly what we have done.[/b][/p][p]We have surrounded ourselves with incredible people. At the heart of the studio is a young, creative, and ambitious team of passionate specialists. [b]Many have not come from large studios or been shaped by the usual way the industry approaches game development.[/b] They bring fresh ideas, high standards, and the same passion that brought us here in the first place.[/p][p]At the same time, we have brought in experienced technical veterans from the industry, helping us build Bodycam on stronger foundations and avoid mistakes we could have made alone.[/p][p]It makes us a particular kind of studio: young, creative, ambitious, and willing to take creative risks, while being supported by people with the technical experience needed to turn those ambitions into reality.[/p][p][b]With this update, we are starting to build the Bodycam we dreamed of making when we launched into Early Access in 2024.[/b] We could not be prouder of what the team has accomplished, and none of it would have been possible without your patience, passion, and continued support.[/p][p][b]Thank you for believing in us and for being part of this journey.[/b][/p][h3][/h3][hr][/hr][h2]Watch the Devlogs

newsitems.title: Bodycam Private Playtest Available Now! | Locked & Loaded
newsitems.author: ReissadStudio
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Bodycam Playtest Is Now Open[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]THIS IS A PRIVATE PLAYTEST. ONLY A LIMITED PORTION OF REGISTERED PLAYERS WILL RECEIVE ACCESS.[/b][/h2][p]
The [b]Locked & Loaded Playtest[/b] is now live and will run until [b]August 31, 2026 at 02:00 UTC.[/b]  This is not an open beta. Access is limited and will be granted progressively to a selected number of players throughout the weekend. The purpose of this test is to stress-test the new systems and matchmaking before the free update launches soon on [b]September 2, 2026.[/b] [/p][h2]
How to Request Access[/h2][p]Request access directly from the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406770/Bodycam/"]Bodycam Steam Store page[/url].

If you are selected, Steam will send a notification and an email to the address linked to your Steam account. The [b]Bodycam Playtest[/b] application will then appear directly in your Steam library.

[b]There is no code required for Steam invitations.
[/b]Please understand that requesting access does not guarantee entry. If you are not invited immediately, further invitations may be sent during the playtest.  [/p][h2]Creator Keys[/h2][p]
Many content creators have received keys to share with their communities. These keys grant direct access to the playtest, so check with your favourite creators for another opportunity to join.

[/p][h2]Everything Is Unlocked[/h2][p]
For this playtest, [b]all weapons, attachments, and customization options are unlocked from the start.[/b]

The full update introduces an economy and progression system, but we want every tester to be able to freely try every loadout and help us test the new customization features.

[b]All progress made during the playtest will be reset before the full update releases.[/b]

[/p][h2]Create and Share Content[/h2][p]
There is [b]no NDA.[/b]

Everyone with access is free to stream, record, post clips, videos, screenshots, reactions, and any other content from the playtest.

Share your best moments using [b]#Bodycam[/b] and [b]#BodycamGame[/b] for a chance to be featured in our community compilation.

[/p][h2]Report Bugs and Feedback[/h2][p]
This playtest is intended to help us identify and fix the most important issues before launch. Bugs may happen, and your feedback will directly help us improve the update.

Report bugs and share your suggestions here:

[url="https://bodycam.featureupvote.com/"]Bodycam Feedback & Bug Tracker[/url]

[/p][h2]The Full Update Is Almost Here[/h2][p]
[b]Locked & Loaded launches as a free update on September 2, 2026.[/b]

If you do not receive playtest access, do not worry. The full update is only a few days away.

Thank you for helping us shape the future of Bodycam.[/p]

Whether you're locating enemies through footsteps, identifying the direction of incoming gunfire, or reacting to explosions in nearby rooms, every sound can change the outcome of a fight.[/p][h2][url="https://youtu.be/Oz66Ek1RYWU?si=pD6BJpXg2KyxMnmX"]🎥 Watch Devlog #2[/url][/h2][previewyoutube="Oz66Ek1RYWU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
In this Devlog, we explain how we've rebuilt Bodycam's audio from the ground up, including:[/p][list][*][p]Our new [b]Organic Reverb[/b] system, which analyzes the environment in real time to generate natural reverberation.[/p][/*][*][p]Realistic sound propagation through corridors, rooms, stairwells, windows, and open spaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved vertical audio, making it easier to determine whether enemies are above or below you.[/p][/*][*][p]Completely reworked weapon audio with new recordings, mixing, handling sounds, and improved suppression effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet cracks, fly-bys, shockwaves, and environmental audio designed to make every firefight more immersive.[/p][/*][*][p]VOIP improvements, footsteps, equipment sounds, drones, RC cars, and countless other audio refinements.[/p][/*][/list][p]Every sound has been redesigned to make combat more immersive while also providing clearer and more reliable gameplay information.[/p][h2]More Devlogs Coming Soon[/h2][p]This is the second part of our four-part Devlog series covering Bodycam's biggest update yet.[/p][p]Still to come:
[/p][list][*][p][b]Devlog #3:[/b] Trenches[/p][/*][*][p][b]Devlog #4:[/b] Player-Driven Improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Each Devlog explores a different aspect of the update, showcasing both the new features and the technology behind them.[/p][p]If you'd like to discover everything included in this major update, don't forget to read the full patch notes.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy Devlog #2, and we'll see you in the next one.[/p]

newsitems.title: Bodycam Major Update Release Date | V0.8 Locked & Loaded
newsitems.author: ReissadStudio
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]BODYCAM v0.8: LOCKED & LOADED RELEASE DATE & DEVLOG SERIES[/b][/h2][p]
Hi everyone,[/p][h3][b]We're excited to officially announce that Bodycam Major Update v0.8: Locked & Loaded will release on September 2, 2026.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This is by far the biggest update we’ve ever created. It introduces new gameplay systems, technologies, animations, audio, maps, progression systems, and much more.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you for your patience![/b][/h3][p]We know this update has taken longer than many of you expected, and we understand the frustration that came with the delays and the quieter periods over the past few months. You were waiting for clear news, and we wanted to make sure that when we spoke, we could do so with real progress and a date we could stand behind.[/p][p]What began as a major content update gradually became a much broader overhaul. Over the past year, Bodycam has grown from a project created by Luca and Leo into a full development studio, with a larger team working toward the same goal: [b]building the strongest FPS experience we can.[/b][/p][p]As development moved forward, it became clear that simply adding more content was not enough. Several of the game’s core systems and internal tools needed to be rebuilt so they would no longer limit the quality, scale, and pace of future updates. That meant making the difficult decision to postpone the Spring Major Update and address those foundations properly.[/p][p]It took more time than we originally planned, but it was the right decision for both this update and the future of Bodycam. [b]The good news is that we’re getting to full completion of this major overhaul.[/b] The result is a stronger technical foundation that will support larger, more polished, and more frequent updates moving forward.[/p][p]With development now entering its final stages, we can confidently confirm that [b]v0.8: Locked & Loaded will release on September 2, 2026.[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nLhNxUkAAX4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Developer Devlog Series[/b][/h3][p]To showcase everything included in [b]Locked & Loaded[/b], we'll be releasing a series of [b]four Developer Devlogs[/b], each exploring a different aspect of the update.[/p][h3] 
[b]Devlog #1: Animation & Loadout - August 19[/b][/h3][p][u][b]On August 19 on the official Bodycam YouTube channel.[/b][/u][/p][p]A showcase of Bodycam's biggest gameplay overhaul yet, introducing redesigned procedural weapon animations, realistic reloads, the new Loadout & Weapon Customization System, hundreds of weapon attachments, the Tactical Tablet, and many more gameplay improvements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44020457/d9d719845426b41dd4aea00f27a5a22434640545.png"][/img][/p][h3] 
[b]Devlog #2: Sound Design - August[/b][/h3][p]A deep dive into Bodycam's completely redesigned audio technologies, showcasing the systems and techniques behind its immersive sound experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44020457/66b95201550b9737685206844629e714cf4e079f.png"][/img][/p][h3] 
[b]Devlog #3: Trenches - August[/b][/h3][p]A showcase of our brand-new map, highlighting the future direction of Bodycam's environments, atmosphere, visual quality, and level design.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44020457/8bc77eb469028c6671eea72183c5baa56049200e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Devlog #4: Players Driven Improvements - August[/b][/h3][p]A complete overview of the quality of life improvements, technical upgrades, optimization work, and community-driven changes implemented throughout the update.

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44020457/ea9c6b1342854e087e0218989f87d571836752a7.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]Playtest[/b][/h3][p]Before release, you'll also have a chance to experience the update during our Playtest.
